title: unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-observability-and-stability-guards
author: Asha Patel
description: Context: This PR enhances unified rollouts by adding observability and stability guards to canary, A/B, and shadow workflows and tightening automated rollback behavior. Motivation: We've seen a few incidents where rollout regressions were not detected early enough by existing metrics, and automated rollbacks either triggered too aggressively or not at all for shadow probing across async traffic. This changeset adds richer telemetry, clearer metric matching between production and shadow probes, and safety gates for staged canaries. Summary of changes: 1) Rollout controller: emit rollout_phase, rollout_step, target_weight, observed_error_rate, p50_p95_latency_ms, probe_success_rate labels; improve state machine to track probing windows and 'quarantined' canary state that prevents weight increases until probes stabilize. 2) Metrics & alerts: add Prometheus histograms and counters for shadow probe latency and success/failure classifications, introduce composite SLI used by autorollback decision logic, and add alert rules for degradation during staged rollouts (thresholds copied from ENG-3214). 3) Autorollback: extend automatic rollback policy to support multi-metric composite decisions with hysteresis and cooldown windows, avoid flapping by using exponential backoff for rollback actions, add explicit reason codes in audit log entries. 4) Observability: dashboard JSON and dashboard tests for per-rollout views, trace link instrumentation for sampled requests, and a set of Grafana panels for canary weight timeline, composite metric trend, and incident breakpoint markers. 5) Tests: add unit tests for rollout state transitions, integration tests for composite-metric evaluation, and e2e scenario tests that exercise shadow probing and rollback paths. 6) Docs & examples: update rollout policy docs and add a quickstart for setting up a shadow probe workload and matching metrics. Commits: ["controller: add rollout phase and step labels to metrics", "metrics: add composite SLI and prometheus rules", "autorollback: multi-metric decision + hysteresis", "dashboard: add per-rollout dashboard + panels", "tests: add unit/integration/e2e for rollout stability", "docs: rollout policy and shadow probe quickstart"]. Changed areas (high-level files): ["services/rollout-controller/controller.go", "services/rollout-controller/metric_evaluator.go", "observability/prometheus/rules/rollouts.yaml", "observability/grafana/dashboards/rollout-overview.json", "pkg/audit/audit_log.go", "e2e/rollouts/shadow_probe_scenarios.yaml", "docs/rollouts/autorollback.md", "sdk/types/rollout_policy.go"]. Review conversation (high-level): Reviewer Jordan Lee: requested more explicit labels on the composite metric to support cross-region aggregation; asked to include reason codes in audit entries. Author reply (Asha): implemented label change and added reason_code field to audit entries; updated tests. Reviewer Miguel Torres: flagged potential noise from histogram buckets for shadow latency; asked to add a sampling policy and upper bound on retention for high-cardinality labels. Author reply: added histogram bucket review and sampling policy for shadow traffic in metrics config. Samir Gupta: requested e2e scenario that simulates intermittent probe failures and verifies cooldown/hysteresis; author added tests. CI summary: initial CI run reported a flaky e2e failure in rollout e2e (timeout on the shadow probe harness) - reran e2e with increased timeouts and tests passed. Final CI: all checks passed (unit, integration, lint, build, e2e). Merge outcome: merged via squash and merge after approvals from Jordan Lee and Miguel Torres; merge commit message references ENG-3214 and ENG-3301. Notes on runtime behavior: rollout controller defaults to conservative canary step schedule when composite SLI is configured; the system will quarantine a canary and hold weight at the last stable step if probe success_rate falls below configured threshold, then either auto-rollback after cooldown or resume when metrics recover. Release notes: "Enhance unified rollouts with observability for canary/AB/shadow workflows, composite metric-driven autorollback with hysteresis, stability guards, and new dashboards and tests." Follow-ups: small perf tuning to metric evaluator under high-cardinality tag loads (ENG-3301) and an optional feature flag to enable extended audit detail in Private deployments. Related items: ENG-3214 for composite SLI design, ENG-3301 for high-cardinality metrics perf tuning.
